rewrites.//: The programme link most people already have now opens the admissions page (same address). The Flutter roadmap stays at /curriculum/product-engineering, and ?present=1 is sent there by the page itself.
The free live class with Altron (and module classes): one page, also reachable without the trailing slash.
The short link for ads and WhatsApp replies: the same admissions page, under a name that reads as a roadmap, not a sales page.
The full pricing is a static page (30 Oct 2026, founder); /unlock, where the app sends people, shows it too on a fresh load.
The roadmap and its lessons are a plain page (30 Oct 2026, founder: the place where people convert); /learn/<module>/<lesson> opens a lesson.
The live classes are a plain page (30 Oct 2026, founder: WhatsApp links must open at once); registering happens in the app at /join/:id.
The app's shell is app.html: index.html is the static home page at the front door (30 Oct 2026, founder; stamp_version.py swaps them after the build).

headers.//: Every route is served the same index.html by the rewrite, but a header rule only matches the literal path. '/' and '/index.html' were covered; '/what-if', '/roadmap/...' and every shared '/live-sessions/:id' link were not, so a visitor on a deep link was pinned to an hour-old app shell and saw the previous build. Placed first so the immutable rules below still claim the assets.

Genuinely immutable: canvaskit, fonts, images and the asset bundle. Named explicitly rather than by extension, because a blanket *.js rule swept up flutter_bootstrap.js and cached the app's entry point for a year.

The app shell. None of these carry a content hash, so a cached copy pins a visitor to whatever version they first loaded. flutter_bootstrap.js is the entry point and was being cached for a year, which is why some people saw a build from days ago while others saw today's.
The 6.5 MB app code: no-store made every visit download it again. no-cache keeps it fresh (the browser asks, and a 304 comes back when it has not changed) without the download (30 Oct 2026).
Everyone arrives at '/', not '/index.html'. The rewrite serves index.html but the header rule above never matched this path, so the front door itself was cached for an hour.

NOT immutable, despite living under /assets/ or ending in .otf. The icon font is rebuilt every release as a subset holding only the icons the app uses, at a fixed URL. Cached for a year, a returning visitor kept the old subset and every icon added since rendered blank (the reorder drag handles). The manifests change the same way. no-cache means revalidate with the ETag (a 304 when unchanged). Last in the list so it overrides the long-cache rules above.

redirects.//: One test, shared. The series link came first and nobody had made a series — the tests exist on their own.
The short link for a shared test series. Keeps what gets pasted into a group on the domain people recognise.
Invoice share links. The short link is what goes into a WhatsApp message; the PDF is served by the backend from an unguessable token.
